xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:RemarksForExchangeNotForWebsit: Gujarat State Financial Corporation is a body corporate established as Statutory Corporation by Government of Gujarat pursuant to Section 3 (1) of the State Financial Corporations Act, 1951, a Parliament statute under Union List 43. Constitution of Board of Directors is governed by Sections 10, 15 and 17 read with Section 4 (3) of the said Act which does not envisage for induction of Independent Directors and hence Corporation is not having independed directors. Corporation took up the matter of exemptions and relaxations as provided earlier with SEBI. SEBI, vide letter dated December 20, 2021, advised the Corporation to take up the matter of amendments to SFCs Act with Government so as to align it with that of LODR. Accordingly, Corporation took up the matter with Government of India through Government of Gujarat vide letter dated December 27, 2021, copies of which are also furnished to SEBI as well as BSE Ltd. Corporation is following up the matter. Till amendments are effected, Corporation may please be continued to file Report in such a manner that it does not violate the provisions of the SFCs Act, 1951 and the Regulations made thereunder.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnComposition: As stated hereinabove, the Board of Directors and its Committees do not have independent directors and to that extent Corporation is non-compliant with the provisions of LODR. Once SFCs Act is amended, we shall comply with the listing requirements in accordance with LODR and till then Corporation may be granted exemption.

Board of Directors and its Committees are constituted in accordance with the provisions contained in the State Financial Corporations Act, 1951 read with SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015. In absence of independent directors, Corporation has requested SEBI to grant relaxations to which SEBI, vide letter dated December 20, 2021, advised the Corporation to take up the matter of amendments to SFCs Act with Government so as to align it with that of LODR. Corporation took up the matter with Government vide letter dated December 27, 2021 with copies to SEBI and BSE Ltd and following up the matter. Since amendments to SFCs Act are yet to take place, this Report is submitted in conformity with SFCs Act, 1951 and affirmations made accordingly.
Integrated Governance Report for the quarter ended June 30, 2025 was placed before the Board of Directors. Board took note of the non-compliances and also noted that the same is because of non-availability of enabling provisions in the SFCs Act and directed to follow up the matter with Government. Report under reference is being placed before the Board of Directors in the ensuing meeting.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:AnyOtherInformationForDisclosu: Gujarat State Financial Corporation is a body corporate established as Statutory Corporation by Government of Gujarat under Section 3 (1) of the State Financial Corporations Act, 1951, a Parliament statute enacted pursuant to Union List 43. The constitution of the Board of Directors is well defined in the SFCs Act, 1951 itself. In absence of relevant provisions, Board and its Committees do not have independent directors. On advise of SEBI vide letter dated December 20, 2021, Corporation, vide letter dated December 27, 2021, represented to Government for amendments to SFCs Act, 1951 so as to align it with that of LODR. Till the amendments are effected, aforesaid non-compliance may please be condoned. Corporation has been requesting to BSE Ltd to waive fine imposed on the Corporation from time to time which may please be considered favourably.
